input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2(a) imposes a Customer-payable stipulated sum on any termination by the Company, calculated as half of the excess of trailing twelve-month Net Sales over $800,000. That formula bears no relation to fees and can far exceed three months of the Section 3.1 fees (30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month), so it fails the LD fallback cap; it is also triggered by any Company termination, not just convenience. Section 1.6 gives us a limited penalty-free exit only if the Site is late, and 4.2(b)-(c) merely handle a zero result and quarterly instalments, so they do not cure the exposure. We took the fallback rather than deleting the payment outright because deleting would require collateral rewrites of the 4.2(b) zero-value and 4.2(c) instalment machinery and the Section 4 heading; the edit caps the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees and makes it our sole early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount. Retained 4.2(b)-(c) remain workable against the capped amount.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company's Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees as its sole early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the Net Sales-based termination formula with our accepted fallback: a single early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, expressly the only liquidated amount we can owe. Our preferred position is no Customer-payable liquidated amount at all, but we can live with this cap.

ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall not exceed the fees payable by the Company pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, which shall be the Company's sole early termination fee and the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company under this Agreement.

mappings.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
